question: Which lifecycle state does plugin @tsuuanmi/system-runtime-codex-sdk have?

reasons: its row runtime-codex-sdk is off in the composition: installed with a valid manifest, and not run
Base runs no plugin beside another with its results unused: shadow runs are not automated
Base gives no plugin a share of the jobs: a canary split is not automated
not default: no row of the composition mounts it (runtime-codex-sdk off)
not retired: the composition names it (runtime-codex-sdk)

rationale: The state follows from the operator's configuration (a row on, off, or gone); the host records it and automates nothing (PROP-0010).
